title: Refresh Linked Excel Charts (DataAndAutomation)

scenarios.title: Refresh Linked Excel Charts applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Refresh Linked Excel Charts (BtnUpdateExcelCharts) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Update Excel Charts refreshes linked charts only (context-menu and shortcut paths)
scenarios.expected: The interactive update behaves as documented on a real PowerPoint host: only Excel-linked charts (linked OLE objects with a source path) are refreshed from their workbook; embedded charts are deliberately left alone; the result dialog counts the refreshed charts; the all-slides variant prompts before more than ten charts; and the zero-linked-charts case reports that instead of claiming success.
ownerSteps: In a deck, insert a linked Excel chart (copy a chart in Excel, then Paste Special -> Paste Link in PowerPoint) plus one embedded chart.
Change the source values in the workbook and save it.
Run the feature on the current slide (and once with the right-click 'update all slides' variant).

Verify the linked chart reflects the new values, the embedded chart is untouched, the dialog counts only the linked chart, and the all-slides confirmation appears when more than ten linked charts exist.
scenarios.technicalReason: Deterministic automation is not feasible for this feature: creating a PowerPoint-linked chart headlessly failed twice (the seam built an Excel workbook chart and used Shapes.PasteSpecial with Link=msoTrue; both runs returned COMException 'Clipboard is empty or contains data which may not be pasted here' even with Excel made visible - the linked-OLE clipboard flavor does not survive the headless round trip), and the feature's Execute always shows a modal MessageBox on every outcome. The deterministic detection and refresh mechanics were extracted into the modal-free ExcelChartUpdateService, which the feature now delegates to, so this owner check only has to confirm the visible behavior.
